color.note: Two themes = two platforms, both dark-only. Same role names, native values: iOS reads Apple's dark semantic colors (use the UIKit/SwiftUI semantic color, not the hex); Android reads the Material 3 dark scheme generated from the aqua seed (fidelity), with primary pinned to the brand aqua.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. iOS: systemBackground (dark). Android: surface.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Lists, sheet bodies, skeletons. iOS: secondarySystemBackground. Android: surfaceContainerLow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Search field, menus, missing-artwork tiles, Android navigation bar. iOS: tertiarySystemBackground. Android: surfaceContainer.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: iOS secondary (bordered) button fill, neutral badges. iOS: systemGray4. Android: surfaceContainerHigh.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only. iOS: separator. Android: outlineVariant.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen (outlined badge, text field). 3:1 on every surface. iOS: systemGray. Android: outline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy and icons on bg, every surface and on scrim. iOS: label. Android: onSurface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, synopsis, inactive tabs, on bg and every surface. iOS: secondaryLabel. Android: onSurfaceVariant.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary captions (codec line, file size) on bg and surface-1 only. iOS: systemGray (not tertiaryLabel, which fails contrast). Android: outline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Electric aqua, the brand. The one FILLED primary action per screen (Play / Resume) and playback progress. iOS: the app tint (AccentColor), so tinted buttons and the selected tab pick it up natively. Android: primary (pinned to the brand value). As text on bg and every surface.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed accent fill in previews. On device use the platform's own press feedback (iOS highlight, Android state layer).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Android: onPrimary.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: New badge (iOS), tonal button and navigation-bar active indicator (Android: secondaryContainer).

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft. Android: onSecondaryContainer.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or word. iOS: systemRed (as text on bg and surface-1 only). Android: error.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Brand rule on both: under any text or control laid over artwork or video. Sized so ink-muted holds 4.5:1 even over white artwork.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Under synopsis text on the hero.

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of a progress bar or scrubber over artwork or video.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: PREVIEW STAND-IN ONLY. iOS: approximates Liquid Glass (.glassEffect / system bars) — on device the system renders it. Android: the opaque navigation-bar container; Android never uses glass.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / switch-access focus ring, 2pt/dp outside a 2pt/dp gap. iOS: system focus ring where available.

tokens.name: avatar-1
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground, chosen from the user's name so the same person always gets the same one; the initial sits on it in ink. The six are muted and equally dark, so none reads as a status or competes with aqua.

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground (see avatar-1).

tokens.name: avatar-3
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground (see avatar-1).

tokens.name: avatar-4
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground (see avatar-1).

tokens.name: avatar-5
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground (see avatar-1).

tokens.name: avatar-6
tokens.usage: Profile tile ground (see avatar-1).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Downloaded / offline-ready: ink with the filled download-done icon and the word "Downloaded" for screen readers. No hue of its own.

styles.name: brand-display
styles.usage: The ONLY brand face: hero title when the item has no Logo image, the VibeyFin wordmark, onboarding. Max 2 lines. Everything else uses the system font.

groups.name: iOS — SF Pro, Dynamic Type (Large default)

styles.name: ios-title2
styles.usage: .title2 bold — detail title fallback, section heads on detail.

styles.name: ios-body
styles.sample: A retired safecracker takes one last job.

styles.name: m3-headline-small
styles.usage: headlineSmall — top app bar title on tab roots (large/medium top app bar).

styles.name: m3-title-large
styles.usage: titleLarge — row headers, detail title fallback.

styles.name: m3-title-medium
styles.usage: titleMedium — sheet titles, list item headlines.

styles.name: m3-body-large
styles.sample: A retired safecracker takes one last job.

spacing.note: One 4-unit grid; pt on iOS, dp on Android.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row header to cards, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone screen margin on both (iOS readable/layout margin, M3 compact margin).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between rows; Android medium-width margin; iPad margin is 20.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section breaks on detail.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding, player transport gaps.

tokens.name: radius-artwork
tokens.usage: Both platforms: posters, thumbnails, hero card. iOS: continuous corners (.rect(cornerRadius: 8, style: .continuous)).

tokens.name: radius-ios-card
tokens.usage: iOS grouped containers and the hero card on iPad; nested corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-m3-xs
tokens.usage: M3 shape extraSmall — Android badges, progress ends.

tokens.name: radius-m3-md
tokens.usage: M3 shape medium — Android cards and menus.

tokens.name: radius-m3-xl
tokens.usage: M3 shape extraLarge — Android bottom-sheet top corners, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons on both (iOS 26 capsules, M3 full), the iOS tab bar, the M3 navigation indicator.

tokens.name: touch-ios
tokens.usage: iOS minimum hit target (44pt).

tokens.name: touch-android
tokens.usage: Android minimum touch target (48dp).

tokens.name: button-ios
tokens.usage: iOS large capsule button height (controlSize .large) for Play / My List.

tokens.name: button-android
tokens.usage: M3 button height (small); use button-android-lg for the hero / detail Play.

tokens.name: button-android-lg
tokens.usage: M3 button height (medium): the detail Play / Resume, and the full-width primary action of a form or sheet (Sign in, Add server).

tokens.name: poster-w
tokens.usage: Poster width on phones (2:3). 140 on medium, 168 on expanded widths.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: Continue-watching thumbnail width on phones (16:9).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Trickplay preview bubble only. Elevation otherwise is native: materials/glass on iOS, tonal surfaces on Android.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Previews only. iOS: SwiftUI .snappy spring. Android: M3 motion scheme fast spatial spring.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Previews; artwork fade-in over the BlurHash on both platforms.

tokens.name: dur-hero
tokens.usage: Hero backdrop crossfade on both; instant with Reduce Motion / Remove animations.
